info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Closes-v4-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access and retrieve a list of support tickets that have been closed. It serves as an essential resource for support teams and customer service professionals to track ticket resolution progress and analyze closure trends. Users can gain insights into the types of issues resolved and the performance of support operations. Typical consumers of this API include support managers, customer service representatives, and business analysts looking to improve service quality and efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to close a specified ticket, indicating that the issue has been resolved. It updates the ticket status to closed in the system.

requestBody.description: The request body containing the necessary parameters to close a ticket in the system. Ensure that the required fields are provided and in the correct format as specified in the schema.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing and is being executed.

ListSupportTicketsClosesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for closing tickets in the operations API. It is expected to be a string representation of the ticket details.

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the request.

resultId.description: The ID of the result generated by this operation.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListSupportTicketsClosesResponse_202.description: Response schema for the close operation on tickets.
